notes.title: CAKE SALE!
notes.content: [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31322528/21f190c98d7780d2e0a90f6841c20e7aad7063fa.png[/img]February is "Cake Month" for us Anglo-Saxons and to celebrate we're offering 25% off Mission 1545 from tomorrow Sat 3rd!
